apiContracts.path: N/A — no REST endpoints in this phase
apiContracts.description: Phase 1 produces shared TypeScript interfaces and classes only (error types, base repository). No HTTP API contracts are introduced.

componentSpecs.name: src/shared/error.types.ts
componentSpecs.description: Exports three domain error classes — NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError — each extending native Error with Object.setPrototypeOf for correct instanceof behavior. Used across all modules per GP-006.

componentSpecs.name: src/shared/base.repository.ts
componentSpecs.description: Exports generic IBaseRepository<T> interface (findById, findAll, create, update, delete) and abstract BaseKnexRepository<T extends { id: string }> class with Knex-based concrete implementations. Constructor accepts Knex instance and tableName string. Foundation for all module repositories per GP-001.

componentSpecs.name: tests/unit/shared/error.types.test.ts
componentSpecs.description: Jest unit tests covering instanceof checks, name, message, and cross-type discrimination for NotFoundError, ValidationError, and ConflictError.

componentSpecs.name: tests/unit/shared/base.repository.test.ts
componentSpecs.description: Jest unit tests covering findById (found and not-found), findAll, create, update, and delete methods of BaseKnexRepository using a mocked Knex instance.
